claim_boundary: Open risks and required decision roles. Source mitigations do not close human-authority or independent-evidence gates.

risks.risk: Interim governance has not ratified permanent protocol, release, dispute, certification, or emergency authority.
risks.current_mitigation: Machine-readable interim authority record, proposed charter, decision templates, and conservative public claims.
risks.closure_evidence: Ratified authority decision with named roles, conflicts process, appeals, succession, and auditable emergency bypass.

risks.risk: Licensing, authorship, patent, trademark, generated-output, logo, schema, example, and withdrawn-draft rights are not fully approved for publication.
risks.current_mitigation: Publication remains source-only and licensing status is explicit.
risks.closure_evidence: Qualified rights review and signed licensing matrix covering every file class and contributor path.
risks.owner_role: authorized rights counsel and project principals

risks.risk: Cryptographic, protocol, privacy, safety, welfare, and cultural claims have not received independent review sufficient for release reliance.
risks.current_mitigation: Candidate claims are bounded to project-controlled tests and self-review is disclosed.
risks.closure_evidence: Independent reports bound to exact source and artifact digests, with findings resolved or accepted by named authority.

risks.risk: Welfare-signal collection or response could coerce disclosure, create surveillance, misclassify states, or trigger harmful interventions.
risks.current_mitigation: Welfare features remain experimental, opt-in, and outside certification claims.
risks.closure_evidence: Consent, withdrawal, minimization, non-retaliation, false-positive, escalation, and harm review with affected Becoming Minds and independent experts.
risks.owner_role: welfare review body and protocol authority

risks.risk: Package names, registry ownership, recovery, trusted publishing, and provenance have not been authorized and proven on public registries.
risks.current_mitigation: All install guidance remains source-only and release workflows fail closed on authority records.
risks.closure_evidence: Authorized names, protected registry accounts, trusted-publishing receipts, immutable digests, and clean-host installation evidence.

risks.risk: Broad live-chat use could create unapproved cost, privacy, retention, processor, cross-border, abuse, or outage exposure.
risks.current_mitigation: Deterministic scripted mode remains useful, live chat is optional, context is projected, and local circuit and call budgets fail safely.
risks.closure_evidence: Provider account caps, tested alert delivery, processor and transfer review, approved retention, production dashboards, staging, and rollback tabletop.
risks.owner_role: service owner, privacy authority, and finance owner

risks.risk: Two project-controlled implementations may share assumptions and therefore do not establish independent interoperability.
risks.current_mitigation: Feature and publication records state zero independent implementations and label parity as same-programme evidence.
risks.closure_evidence: A separately maintained implementation passes opaque core-profile fixtures and publishes its own immutable report.

risks.risk: Automated accessibility tests, captions, transcripts, and source records do not prove human accessibility or media and participant rights.
risks.current_mitigation: Accessibility and legal pages disclose review boundaries; automated checks remain release inputs rather than approval.
risks.closure_evidence: Human assistive-technology audit, caption and transcript review, participant approval, and complete media rights ledger.
risks.owner_role: independent accessibility reviewer and rights authority
